# MVP Health Care

> > Regional health insurance provider serving New York and Vermont with Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Individual & Family plans, and provider resources.

MVP Health Care offers comprehensive health insurance coverage including Medicare Advantage, New York State Medicaid, Child Health Plus, and Individual & Family plans. The organization provides extensive provider resources, policy updates, and wellness programs like MVP Living Well, with digital tools including the Gia by Galileo mobile app for virtual care.

## Key Topics

- MVP Health Care
- Medicare Advantage
- New York State Medicaid
- Child Health Plus
- Gia by Galileo app
- MVP Living Well Programs
- HARP (Health and Recovery Plan)
- Part D prescription coverage
- Provider credentialing
- Prior authorization
- Medical policy updates
- Preventive care
- DualAccess (D-SNP)
- Vermont coverage
- Be Well Rewards

## Health Insurance Plans

- [Individual & Family Health Insurance](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/plans/individual-family): Individual & family plans in NY/VT with Gia app and Child Health Plus
- [Free and Low-Cost Health Insurance Options New York](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/plans/medicaid/free-low-cost-options): NY Medicaid, Child Health Plus, and Harmonious Health Care Plan options
- [Plan Details](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/plans/medicare/plan-details): Medicare plan details and member portal access for HMO-POS enrollment
- [Be Well Rewards for Medicare and DualAccess (DSNP)](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/plans/medicare/be-well-rewards): $100 reward card for Medicare/DualAccess annual wellness visit completion

## Provider Resources

- [Find Provider Directory for Providers](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/providers/find-a-doctor): Provider directory search tool for in-network referrals via HealthSparq
- [MVP Contact Information for Providers](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/contact-us/for-providers-resources): Provider contact info for credentialing, COB, prior auth, and utilization
- [Contacting MVP About Provider Claims](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/contact-us/for-provider-claims): Provider claims submission via EDI, CMS-1500, UB-04 and appeals process
- [Cultural Competency Training](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/providers/education/cultural-competency-training-for-providers): NCQA-required cultural competency training and attestation for providers
- [Medicaid Foster Home Training for Providers](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/providers/education/provider-medicaid-childrens-foster-care-training): NY State required VFCA Medicaid foster care training and attestation

## Policy Updates & Communications

- [Provider Policies and Payment Policies Effective October 1, 2024](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/providers/communications-center/mvp-process-updates/2024-q4-provider-policies-and-payment-policies-effective-october-1-2024): October 2024 provider and payment policy updates for billing and claims
- [October 2024 Medical Policy Updates](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/providers/communications-center/formulary-policy-updates/2024-q4-medical-policy-updates): October 2024 medical policy updates including FISH and POEM procedures
- [February 2024 Medical Policy Updates](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/providers/communications-center/formulary-policy-updates/2024-q1-medical-policy-updates): Q1 2024 medical policy updates for providers
- [February 2024 Formulary Policy Updates](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/providers/communications-center/formulary-policy-updates/2024-q1-formulary-policy-updates): Q1 2024 formulary updates with FDA approvals and prior authorization changes

## Member Support & Tools

- [When to Use the Gia Mobile App](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/when-should-i-use-gia): Gia by Galileo mobile app guide for virtual care and urgent medical advice
- [MVP Living Well Programs for Your Patients](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/providers/communications-center/important-updates/2025-q2-mvp-living-well-programs-for-your-patients): Free virtual/in-person wellness programs for patients including caregiving
- [Teen Healthy Habits](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/members/resources/health-wellness/teens-healthy-habits): Teen health resources covering nutrition, exercise, sleep, and stress mgmt
- [Report Health Insurance Overpayments](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/contact-us/reporting-overpayments): Provider overpayment self-disclosure per Section 363d Social Services Law

## Optional

- [MVP-medicare-seminar12345](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/about/events/medicare-seminar/mvp-medicare-seminar-12345): Medicare Advantage seminar in Tarrytown, Hudson Valley covering Part D
- [MVP-medicare-seminar11998](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/about/events/medicare-seminar/2026-mvp-medicare-seminar-11998): Virtual 2026 Medicare Advantage seminar covering Part D drug coverage
- [Sleep Challenge](https://www.mvphealthcare.com/about/events/living-well/sleep-challenge-1523): Self-guided virtual Sleep Challenge wellness program event
